prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: opaque settlement-panel header illustration for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game; one separate image, 1536x640 pixels, very wide 12:5 landscape composition.
Input images: Image 1 (site-city.png) and Image 2 (site-mill.png) are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: weathered masonry and timber, broad-brush black ink contours and hatching, muted earthy wash, rugged hand-drawn materials. Image 2 especially guides ruined mill materials, but do not reproduce its isolated map-icon composition or transparent background.
Primary request: Staraya Melnitsa, the yard of a ruined watermill at dusk. A broken waterwheel beside the stream, a partly collapsed shingle roof exposing snapped rafters, ruined stone walls, a clearly visible closed wooden cellar hatch set into the yard with iron hinges, and trampled mud with ruts and puddles. The mill is abandoned and structurally ruined; the cellar hatch must be recognizable in the middle-ground yard, not hidden by rubble.
Composition/framing: wide three-quarter elevated view into the ruined mill yard and stream edge. Broken wheel, collapsed roof, cellar hatch and trampled mud all readable within the central wide horizontal band. Full-bleed continuous landscape and sky, no border, no isolated diorama.
Lighting/mood: late autumn, overcast dusk, fading cold gray-blue light; unsettling quiet dark fantasy grounded in practical rural medieval construction, not bright daylight.
Style/medium: broad expressive black ink brush lines, irregular hand-hatched shadows, muted earthy watercolor wash; weathered sepia timber, stone gray, peat brown mud, cold desaturated slate-blue twilight. Match both references' hand-worked material character, not glossy photorealism or 3D rendering.
Constraints: fully opaque image edge to edge. No people in the foreground, preferably no people anywhere. No text, letters, numbers, runes, logos, symbols, signatures or watermarks. No invented supernatural figures. Original setting; do not imitate any existing game or artist.
